headline: Metrorex Union Threatens to Stop the Metro in September if Compensation Is Not Paid
summary: The Free Union of Metro Workers warned the metro will stop in September 2026 if the Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure does not pay compensation. The warning was issued in a statement on Wednesday.
why: Metrorex operates Bucharest's metro system, and labour disputes over pay can disrupt urban transport and public finances. The ministry funds the operator's obligations.
